{{Quote|Now leave! Before I gut you like a Letaki's dinner!|[[Aurra Sing/Legends|Aurra Sing]] to [[Gardulla Besadii the Elder/Legends|Gardulla the Hutt]]|<ref name="SWO 12" />}}
The '''Letaki''' were a [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] beings distinguished by eight [[Limb/Legends|tentacles]], an [[Egg/Legends|egg]]-shaped head, four [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], and a sharp beak. Two sets of gills allowed them to breathe in both [[Atmosphere/Legends|air]] and [[Water/Legends|water]]. They were able to focus their eyes on more than one object at a [[Time/Legends|time]], and to use their limbs to manipulate several items independently. As [[Diet/Legends|carnivores]], Letaki gutted their dinners. The Letaki vocal range was higher than that of most species. The [[Musician/Legends|musician]] [[Evar Orbus/Legends|Evar Orbus]], leader of [[Evar Orbus and His Galactic Jizz-Wailers]], was a Letaki.

==Biology and appearance==
[[File:DoikkNats-TVD.jpg|160px|thumb|180px|left|The Letaki species' sense of hearing was inferior to that of another species, the Bith (pictured).]]
With eight [[Limb/Legends|tentacles]] and at least two feet, the Letaki were a non-[[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="ATBPO" /> They were able to use several tentacles in tandem, which allowed a Letaki [[Musician/Legends|musician]] to play a number of instruments simultaneously. The sheer multiplicity of their appendages made it difficult for non-Letaki to keep all the manipulators apart, a weakness that the Letaki [[Evar Orbus/Legends|Evar Orbus]] exploited by wearing a prosthetic arm in which he hid a weapon. At least some Letaki sported [[Color/Legends|pink]] skin mottled with a darker shade.<ref name="WWMRB" />

An ovoid head sat atop the Letaki neck and torso.<ref name="WWMRB" /> The [[Egg/Legends|egg]]-shaped [[Bone/Legends|cranium]] featured four<ref name="CSWE II 251">{{CSWECite|II|251|Letaki}}</ref> shiny, [[Color/Legends|black]] [[Eye/Legends|eyes]]; a sharp, stubby, yellow [[Mouth/Legends|beak]]; and two pointed [[Ear/Legends|ears]].<ref name="WWMRB" /> A Letaki was able to focus each of the four visual organs independently, an ability that allowed members of the species to monitor several directions at once. Their sense of hearing was comparatively less developed, falling below the aural capabilities of the [[Bith/Legends|Bith]] species.<ref name="ATBPO" /> The Letaki tongue was dark pink in color. Six short, fleshy appendages with ventral suction cups formed a line across the brow.<ref name="WWMRB" /> Letaki had two sets of gills, which enabled them to breathe both in an [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] and [[Water/Legends|underwater]].<ref name="FF M1" /> The air gills resembled flaps of skin,<ref name="CSWE II 419">{{CSWECite|II|419|Orbus, Evar}}</ref> located behind the eyes.<ref name="SWE 177">''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref>

Letaki had male and female [[Gender/Legends|genders]].<ref name="ATBPO" /> They were [[Diet/Legends|carnivores]] who gutted their dinner before eating it.<ref name="SWO 12" /> When he encountered a group of Letaki<ref name="RE" /> around [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]],<ref name="RE date">{{WebCite|url=https://marthawells.livejournal.com/526309.html|text=The Star Wars Leia Book|work=[https://marthawells.livejournal.com marthawells.livejournal.com]|archivedate=20130120232348}}</ref> the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] assumed the Letaki beak would make drinking difficult; nevertheless, the Human found the tentacled beings' behavior erratic and assumed they were intoxicated.<ref name="RE" /> Letaki [[Blood/Legends|blood]] was colored green.<ref name="ATBPO" /> The species was capable of prodigious vocal abilities; the voice of Evar Orbus, for instance, ranged across eleven [[sectave]]s.<ref name="WWMRB" />

==Society and culture==
Letaki used their tentacles to gesture and point during communication. They expressed emotions through their sense organs, which fluttered to convey feelings.<ref name="ATBPO" /> Conversely, Han Solo assumed that Letaki likely would not to be able to read the subtleties of Human facial expressions.<ref name="RE" /> At least some Letaki were comfortable in arid environments like that of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. Members of the species were known to wear clothing.<ref name="ATBPO" />

==Letaki in the galaxy==
{{Quote|Wait! I'm Evar Orbus!''"<br />"''So?''"<br />"''Of the Evar Orbus Galactic Jizz-wailers. Perhaps you've heard of us?|Evar Orbus and a Bith musician|<ref name="ATBPO" />}}
[[File:Max_Rebo.jpg|thumb|right|Max Rebo, who took over Evar Orbus's band following the latter's death]]
One Letaki who gained a level of prominence in the galaxy was Evar Orbus, a musician<ref name="ATBPO" /> native to the planet [[Letaki (planet)|Letaki]],<ref name="SETSB">''[[Star Wars Trilogy Sourcebook, Special Edition]]''</ref> who founded a [[Band/Legends|band]] known as [[Evar Orbus and His Galactic Jizz-Wailers]].<ref name="WWMRB" /> When Orbus and his group made their way to Tatooine under a contract to play at the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Chalmun/Legends|Chalmun's]] [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina/Legends|cantina]], Orbus felt he had hit the big time.<ref name="ATBPO" /> However, the cantina's current band, [[Figrin D'an and the Modal Nodes/Legends|Figrin D'an and the Modal Nodes]],<ref name="WWMRB" /> resented the competition; under the pretense of sending an [[Airbus/Legends|airbus]] to transport Orbus and his group to their new performance venue, they attacked the Letaki and his crew. Although Orbus was able to defend himself with a weapon hidden in a fake tentacle, he was [[Death/Legends|fatally]] wounded in the skirmish. The other members of his group, under the nominal leadership of the [[Ortolan/Legends|Ortolan]] [[Max Rebo/Legends|Max Rebo]], renamed themselves the [[Max Rebo Band/Legends|Max Rebo Band]] and found work for [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt]].<ref name="FF M1" />

Around [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]],<ref name="RE date" /> a group of Letaki was present within a played-out [[Unidentified asteroid mine|asteroid mine]]. The Letaki were approached by the Human [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Alia Terae]], whom they told about the [[Slavery/Legends|slave trade]] that passed through the [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] and the path through the [[Mining/Legends|mine's]] tunnels to reach the slave holding pens. Terae then led her companions, Han Solo and the Human [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Sian Tesar]], per the Letaki's instructions.<ref name="RE">''[[Razor's Edge]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Author [[John Gregory Betancourt]] created the Letaki Evar Orbus for his short story "[[And the Band Played On: The Band's Tale]]," which was included in the [[1996]] [[Bantam Spectra]] collection ''[[Tales from Jabba's Palace]]''.<ref name="ATBPO" /> In [[2002]], the [[The Official Star Wars Fact File 46|forty-sixth issue]] of ''[[The Official Star Wars Fact File]]'' magazine misspelled the species's name as "Lataki."<ref name="FF M1" /> The species was first visually depicted when Orbus was drawn by artist [[Justine Mara Andersen]] for the article "[[Who's Who in the Max Rebo Band]]," published in the<ref name="WWMRB" /> [[April 15]], [[2003]]<ref name="SW.com">{{SWArchive|url=community/news/2003/03/news20030317.html|text=Celebrate <i>Jedi</i>'s 20th in ''Insider'' #67}}</ref> [[Star Wars Insider 67|sixty-seventh issue]] of the ''[[Star Wars Insider]]'' magazine, but the portrait lacks<ref name="WWMRB" /> the additional pair of eyes and visible gills which ''The Official Star Wars Fact File'' 46 describes Orbus as having, characteristic of his species.<ref name="FF M1" />
